html: The 2027 dates are out, but when I last checked IWM hadn’t published the 2027 parking or shuttle details yet. The parking, free shuttle and ticket prices below are from 2026. I would suggest checking everything again once the 2027 details are released. Leaving a Duxford Air Show can take a long time. It’s very common to queue to get out of the car parks and back onto the M11. My tip is either to leave before the flying display ends or, if you’re able to, spend more time looking around the static displays and the museum hangars and grab some food while the rush leaves. This has worked for me in the past. IWM's getting here page ↗
